capability.untrusted: Folders of an untrusted workspace are never shared with DevMate clients.
capability.virtual: DevMate works on folders of the local file system.
config.runtimeInstanceDirectory: DevMate runtime state directory. Leave empty for ~/.devmate/runtime. Every editor window, other editors and the CLI that use the same directory share one runtime.
config.nodeCommandPath: Absolute path of a Node.js 24+ executable installed on this computer. Leave empty to find one on PATH and in the usual install locations.
config.runtimePort: Loopback HTTP port used when this editor starts the runtime. A runtime that is already running keeps its own port.
config.autoStart: Start the shared DevMate runtime, and its configured connection, when a window with a trusted local folder opens, and start it again if it ends unexpectedly. Off by default: starting is otherwise explicit.
config.shareFolders: What connected AI clients may do in a trusted local folder you open, until you decide otherwise for that folder with DevMate: Change Folder Sharing. Folders of an untrusted workspace are never shared.
config.shareFolders.readWrite: Share each trusted folder with connected AI clients, read and write. The window says so once and you can change any folder later.
config.shareFolders.readOnly: Share each trusted folder read only.
config.shareFolders.never: Share nothing unless you do it with DevMate: Change Folder Sharing.
config.shareEditorContext: Let connected AI clients see the active file, the selection, the open files and the diagnostics of shared folders in this window.
